contactNumber.title: Contact number
contactNumber.desc: The number members call after they unlock your contact
contactNumber.loginNote: You sign in with +91 {{phone}}. A different contact number here does not change how you sign in. Each new number is verified by a code.

setPassword.title: Password
setPassword.desc: You sign in with Google, so there is no password on your account.

setPassword.button: Email me a link to set a password

account.darkModeDesc: Switch between light and dark theme
account.elderModeDesc: Larger text and higher contrast for easier reading

privacy.saveFailed: Could not save your privacy settings. Try again.
privacy.visibilityDesc: Control who can discover and view your profile
privacy.loadErrorDesc: We couldn't confirm your current settings, so nothing is shown rather than risk saving the wrong ones over them. Try again.
privacy.matchesOnlyNote: With "Matches Only", only members you have already liked can send you an interest, and only your matches can open your profile.
privacy.incognitoDesc: Browse without leaving a trace: your visits are not recorded, and you stay out of search and daily matches until you switch it off.
privacy.hidePhotos: Hide my photos until we match
privacy.hidePhotosDesc: Members you haven't matched with see your initials instead of your photos.
privacy.sharedDesc: Choose who sees your contact details, income and birth details: everyone, only your matches, or no one

contact.label: Phone number and email
contact.hint: Who can use an unlock to see them. "Only me" means nobody, even a paid member.

income.label: Income
income.hint: Also stops people finding you with an income filter

birthDetails.label: Birth time and place
birthDetails.hint: Used for horoscope reports; your star sign match still works

options.everyone: Everyone who can see my profile

privacy.activityDesc: Choose what others can see about your online activity
privacy.showOnlineDesc: Let others see when you're online
privacy.showLastSeenDesc: Let others see when you were last active
privacy.blockedDesc: Blocked members can't message, call or find you, and you won't see them

notifications.matchesDesc: When you and another member like each other (app, push and email)

notifications.desc: Choose which alerts you want to receive

verification.submitted: Selfie submitted. We will review within 24 hours.
verification.submitFailed: Could not submit your selfie. Try again.
verification.title: Photo Verification
verification.desc: Get a verified badge by matching a selfie to your profile photos
verification.approvedDesc: Your profile is verified and trusted by other members
verification.badgeNote: You have a verified badge on your profile, a signal other members trust.
verification.reviewNote: We typically review selfies within 24 hours. You'll receive an email when it's done.
verification.formDesc: Get a verified badge by matching a selfie to your profile photos. No documents needed.
verification.privacyNote: Your selfie is captured live from your camera (no uploads) and only used by our team to verify your profile photos. It is never shown to other members.

danger.changeFailed: Could not change that. Try again.
danger.deleteFailed: Could not delete your account. Try again.
danger.title: Pause or delete
danger.desc: Take a break without losing anything, or delete your account
danger.scheduledTitle: Your account is scheduled for deletion
danger.scheduledBody: It will be permanently deleted on {{date}}. Your profile is hidden until then. Changed your mind? Cancel and everything stays as it was.
danger.pausedBody: Nobody can find or open your profile, and you cannot send or answer interests until you resume. Nothing has been deleted.
danger.pauseBody: Hide your profile from search and suggestions for now. Your matches, messages and details stay, and you can resume any time.
danger.deleteBody: Erases your profile, photos, matches and messages. Your profile is hidden straight away and the deletion happens after 30 days, so you can change your mind by signing in and cancelling. After that it cannot be undone. Payment records and any safety reports about you are kept as the law and our <anchor>policies</anchor> require.
danger.paidNote: You have an active membership. Deleting your account ends it straight away and the remaining time is not refunded. See the <anchor>refund policy</anchor> first if you think you are owed a refund.
danger.copyPrompt: Want a copy of your information? <btn>Download my data first</btn>.
danger.googleConfirm: You signed up with Google. Confirm with the same Google account.
danger.nowWarning: Everything is erased now and this cannot be undone.
danger.laterNote: Your account will be deleted in 30 days; you can cancel before then.
danger.deleteNowCheckbox: Delete immediately instead of waiting 30 days
danger.googleUnavailable: Google confirmation isn't available right now. Contact support to delete your account.

twoStep.title: Two-step verification
twoStep.desc: Asks for a code from an authenticator app when you sign in, so a stolen password alone is not enough.
twoStep.startFailed: Could not start setup. Try again.
twoStep.codeWrong: That code is not right. Try again.
twoStep.disableFailed: Could not turn it off. Check your password and code.
twoStep.requiredWarning: Your role needs this turned on before you can use the admin or marketing areas.
twoStep.addKey: In your authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Authy, 1Password…) add an account and enter this key:
twoStep.openInApp: Open in an authenticator app on this device
twoStep.saveCodes: Save these recovery codes somewhere safe. Each works once if you lose your phone. They are shown only now.
twoStep.offCodeLabel: Code from the app (or a recovery code)
